searchText: Who runs ethereum-magicians.org? Currently, the site is configured such that the same person cannot post more than 3 comments in a row. This is particularly problematic when you setup a discussions-to for an EIP and you post regular updates to that thread as you iterate on the EIP. It means that after the first 3 updates, you cannot post any more until someone else comments, which means that anyone who subscribed to the thread to "follow discussion/progress" won't actually see that discussion/progress. This is doubly problematic when you have discussions on Twitter, Reddit, Discord, GitHub, video chat, audio chat, live chat, etc. and you want to post discussion updates to the discussions-to thread to keep the discussion centered there. I am in this exact situation right now and it is very frustrating. So... can we please remove that limit? Pretty sure it's <@!250259755484839957> ? Yes, I am the maintainer of the Magicians' Forum, I'll look into this change <@!301186049323958275> I don't see this particular type of rate limit, do you have the error message you encountered? Ok I have found it in a different section (Discourse has dozens of these kinds of settings). I set "max consecutive replies" to 5 <@!250259755484839957> Why do we need a limit at all?
